theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_tchart_unique_row
theorems.statement: ∀ (p a : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → 1 ≤ a → let R := ZMod (p ^ a); ∀ r s : R, (∃ x y : R, x * r + y * s = 1) → ∃! c : R ⊕ {z : R // p ∣ z.val}, match c with | Sum.inl t => ∃ u : Rˣ, r = (u : R) ∧ s = (u : R) * t | Sum.inr z => ∃ u : Rˣ, r = (u : R) * z.1 ∧ s = (u : R)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
